name: feature.workflow-author.nodes
description: AI Workflow Author node pack — the meta-workflow building blocks that author OTHER workflows over the ctx.features['workflow-author'] surface. draft (LLM authors a graph from the live node catalog), validate (re-check against the closed-world catalog + registration contract), persist (register the validated WorkflowDefinition). Wired draft→validate→persist they are the workflow-builder brain.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Workflow Author: Draft
nodes.description: Reads the live node catalog as a closed-world menu and calls the LLM to author a candidate WorkflowDefinition for a natural-language intent, repairing on validation errors up to maxAttempts. Requires ctx.callAI + ctx.features['workflow-author'].

nodes.label: Workflow Author: Validate
nodes.description: Re-checks a candidate WorkflowDefinition against the closed-world node catalog + the shared registration contract (structural + RFC 0022 §C gate). Fails the run when invalid so persist never fires.

nodes.label: Workflow Author: Get
nodes.description: Read an EXISTING registered WorkflowDefinition by id (or, with no id, list the registered-workflow index) so a revision grounds on the real definition instead of blind re-authoring. Read-only.

nodes.label: Workflow Author: Persist
nodes.description: Registers a validated WorkflowDefinition through the shared registration path, so it becomes runnable and READY TO OPEN on the builder canvas — nothing navigates for the user. Output carries the authored workflowId.
